purpose: Year-by-year reporting only for the user-identified leading Monster and Core references; no model selection or tuning.

monster.candidate_pool: V7 tail_cdf>=0.999 AND immediately previous XTKS-session market median ret5<=0 AND signal-date ret10<=0.5735294117647058
monster.detection_policy: Emit every passing candidate; multiple symbols/day; no Top-N cap. Apply one immediately prior official-XTKS-session same-symbol cooldown to all candidates detected on that prior session. Report raw pool and post-cooldown detections separately.
monster.target: Next official XTKS session open to close of the fifth official session including entry; canonical daily-OHLCV label.

year_coverage.2022: NOT_AVAILABLE: preserved V7 tail feature cache has no 2022 scores; do not reconstruct from daily OHLCV.
year_coverage.2023: Frozen descriptive replay; prior candidate-family exposure exists.
year_coverage.2024: Frozen descriptive replay; prior candidate-family exposure exists.
year_coverage.2025: One user-requested retrospective report-only replay; prior A/B diagnostics had exposure. No tuning or selection from these results.
year_coverage.2026: NOT_AVAILABLE: preserved V7 tail feature cache ends in 2025; do not infer scores from daily bars.

monster.outcome_columns_in_tail_cache: Must not be loaded or used; derive labels from preserved daily OHLCV after freezing the audit spec.

core.reference: V29 fixed_min98_both, the strongest numeric Core reference previously reported; not a full-universe candidate.
core.exact_annual_replay: NOT_REPLAYABLE_FROM_PRESERVED_INPUTS unless raw historical hourly/four-hour signal inputs plus date-effective 350-symbol watchlist and teacher rows are recovered.
core.rule: Do not approximate V29 with daily indicators or synthesize intraday bars. Keep its existing aggregate result separate; no annual symbol rows can be claimed.

evaluation.report: Signal-level metrics and equal-weight complete daily cohort separately, with unresolved/partial coverage disclosed; include +10/+20/+50/-10/-20, win, Top1/Top3 exclusion, monthly/weekly/symbol concentration.
evaluation.unresolved: Never drop or replace unresolved detections. Partial daily cohorts do not enter complete-cohort means.
evaluation.cross_model_comparison: No direct ranking: V29 and Monster have different signal populations and target timing.

prior_exposure: Prior reports have exposed 2023/2024 Monster results and some 2025 pairwise diagnostics. Every annual output is RETROSPECTIVE_PROVISIONAL, not true OOS.
